verdict.rationale: Vercel documents built-in observability for traffic, function performance, and errors, plus custom metrics analyzed in Observability. Its official MCP exposes a `get_web_analytics` tool for querying visitors, page views, and custom events, which confirms built-in visitor analytics; the toolbar can also inspect performance. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party Web Analytics or real-user performance (Core Web Vitals) documentation page in the evidence, detail on dashboards and visitor-behavior depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can track site performance and visitor behavior with built-in analytics

citations.quote: Monitor traffic, function performance, and errors with framework-aware insights across your apps and AI workflows.
`get_web_analytics` ("query visitors, page views, and custom events")
